Package Pr22.Events

Event-related enumerations and classes.

See: Description

  • Interface Summary 
    Interface Description
    AuthBegin
    Occurs when an authentication task of an ECard is started.
    AuthFinished
    Occurs when an authentication task of an ECard is finished.
    AuthWaitForInput
    Occurs when an authentication task of an ECard is waiting for some input data.
    Connection
    Occurs when the used device is disconnected, or when the number of devices is changed while no device is used.
    DeviceUpdate
    Occurs when reading or writing of a file stored on the device is started.
    DocFrameFound
    Occurs when a new cropped document image is available.
    FileChecked
    Occurs when a file hash checking task of an ECard is finished.
    FingerImageUpdated
    Occurs when a finger image of better quality has been scanned (plain) or when additional part of image is scanned (rolling).
    FingerPositioning
    Occurs when an image is scanned during plainScan task to report FingerPositioningFailures.
    ImageScanned
    Occurs when an image is scanned.
    KeyPressed
    Occurs when a button of the device is pressed or released.
    PowerChanged
    Occurs when the state of the power is changed.
    PresenceStateChanged
    Occurs when the state of the presence detection is changed.
    PreviewCaptured
    Occurs when a preview (live) image is captured.
    ReadBegin
    Occurs when a reading task of an ECard is started.
    ReadFinished
    Occurs when a reading task of an ECard is finished.
    ScanFinished
    Occurs when a scanning task is finished.
    ScanStarted
    Occurs when scanning of a page is started.
  • Class Summary 
    Class Description
    AuthEventArgs
    Arguments for ECard authentication events.
    ButtonEventArgs
    Arguments for button pressing events.
    ConnectionEventArgs
    Arguments for device connection events.
    DetectionEventArgs
    Arguments for object presence detection events.
    FileEventArgs
    Arguments for ECard reading events.
    FingerEventArgs
    Arguments for finger positioning events.
    FingerUpdateEventArgs
    Arguments for finger image related events.
    ImageEventArgs
    Arguments for image related events.
    PageEventArgs
    Arguments for page related events.
    PowerEventArgs
    Arguments for device power events.
    PreviewEventArgs
    Arguments for preview (live) image capture events.
    UpdateEventArgs
    Arguments for device usage related events.
